files.rationale: Kept PR A's switch to sqlalchemy_lifespan with seed_database defined before the app (dropping the hand-written lifespan, AsyncSessionMaker and unused imports) while adopting PR B's lint-friendly trailing-comma formatting of the model columns.

Kept PR A's optional import block, which already carries B's noqa F401 fix and additionally exports sqlalchemy_lifespan; the flag is referenced nowhere else, so A's has_sqlalchemy name supersedes B's HAS_SQLALCHEMY rename.
PR A only reformatted these lines, so PR B's typing tweaks (pyright ignores, TypeEngine[Any] -> type[Any]) are taken on top of the shared modernized code.

Took PR B's snake_case variable names, `is` type comparisons and trailing-comma formatting (making A's file-level ruff noqa unnecessary) while keeping PR A's `import types` and UnionType-aware Optional assertions and the lowercase list comment needed by the PEP 604 mixin output.
